dedupe_keys.name: thermal camera in infrastructure dataset tlid

description: The Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt team publishes TLID observations from fixed thermal cameras and LiDAR sensors at city intersections and the CARISSMA test track. Zenodo provides a ZIP free under CC BY 4.0. The linked primary README identifies 7,070 labelled images, 5,028 point clouds and approximately 48,000 two-dimensional labels across eight classes; 4,662 images have synchronised point clouds. These observations can benchmark traffic-participant perception and sensor-fusion components in infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers TLID. Coverage is selected Ingolstadt sites, and acquisition dates and detailed sensor calibration are not established here. The GitHub documentation has a BSD licence, while the deposited dataset retains its own CC BY terms. Partial synchronisation and class distribution limit direct comparisons across all samples. No archive was downloaded, labels audited or open-set detection results reproduced.
name: Thermal Camera in Infrastructure Dataset - TLID
notes: G6 item G6-1450. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.  Cited as: Open-Set Object Detection for the Identification and Localization of Dissimilar Novel Classes by means of Infrastructure Sensors. IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium, 2024..
